confirm_body_1: Save any open forms. Open terminals and agent sessions will be closed on restart (Claude conversations are saved and can be resumed). Running backups and workflows block the update until they finish. A private backup will be verified before the code is replaced.
confirm_body_2: The console will be unavailable for a few moments. If the new version fails, the updater will try to restore the previous one. Keep an external backup as well.
job_default_detail: Follow the steps. Your local data will be preserved.
